paragraphs: ScholarPredict is a data-driven machine learning system that predicts the academic performance category of a student using the Random Forest algorithm. The project's primary objective is to build an accurate and interpretable ensemble classification model that identifies students who are likely to perform poorly early in the semester, demonstrating a practical application of educational data mining and machine learning to improve student outcomes.

Through this system, mentors and faculty can provide timely academic support, showcasing how an ensemble learning algorithm like Random Forest can be applied to solve a real-world educational problem effectively. The proposed ScholarPredict system provides a practical and interpretable approach to early academic intervention, with potential extensions to applications such as mentor dashboards, personalized study recommendations, dropout risk detection, and institutional performance analysis.

The project has successfully implemented the end-to-end Machine Learning data pipeline, feature extraction, and predictive inference. It is operational without cloud latency, showcasing its effectiveness in real-world scenarios.
